text:
Maya (Infra): quick heads-up — noticed committed reserve credits didn't attach to the last GCP invoice for our reserved GPU pool in us-west. cost looks ~28k for the month, but committed discount of ~15k not applied. :grimacing:
Raj (Billing): ouch. invoice id? did the credit expire or is it a mapping issue?
Maya (Infra): invoice `INV-2026-03-09-GCP-7832`. credits are contract credits (reserved capacity) not promos. they should be auto-applied to the billing account that maps to our committed contract.
Taylor (EngOps): tagging mismatch is my hunch — when we migrated instances to the new cluster the billing tag `redwood:commit=dedicated-usw` might not have propagated. last deploy had the networking migration.
Oli (SRE): ran a quick check in the billing export — entries for those GPU instance IDs show `project_label_commit` = null for most hours on 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-07. here's the snippet:```csv
resource_id,usage_start,usage_end,project_label_commit,cost
gpu-xyz,2026-03-01T00:00,2026-03-01T01:00,,45.12
gpu-xyz,2026-03-01T01:00,2026-03-01T02:00,,44.88
```
Maya (Infra): yep that's the problem — commit label missing so GCP didn't apply the contract credit. looks like a rollout of the new fleet agent removed the label in the userdata script.
Raj (Billing): what's the ETA to backfill labels? can GCP do a retroactive credit if we provide proof?
Oli (SRE): we can tag the running resources in our accounting export but retroactive tag injection into GCP billing line items is not possible from our side. need to open a support ticket with GCP to request a backfill for those line items and attach the export showing they should have been under committed account.
Maya (Infra): I'll open the GCP support case and link the billing export + deployment change log. adding the sample rows + invoice id.
Raj (Billing): thanks. FYI we also have ~2.5k in promo/marketing credits that expire 2026-04-15 — not related to this invoice but worth flagging for the next cycle so we don't lose them.
Taylor (EngOps): can we confirm the committed capacity usage windows? if usage was actually on a different region (us-central) we may not be eligible.
Oli (SRE): filtered logs show 96% of the GPU hours were in `us-west1-a` during the affected window. I'll attach an aggregated per-region breakdown to the ticket.
billing-bot: Automated update: invoice `INV-2026-03-09-GCP-7832` processed at 2026-03-10T09:12:00Z, status: paid. Customer-specified credits not applied.
Raj (Billing): if GCP refuses backfill we may need to do a manual ledger correction for the quarter. can you capture exact dollar amounts per day so finance can estimate impact?
Maya (Infra): will do. provisional numbers: total charge 28,164.20 USD, committed credit expected 15,200.00 USD, shortfall ~12,964.20.
Taylor (EngOps): quick mitigation: add a post-deploy check to verify `project_label_commit` before we spin GPUs, and a CI gate for the fleet agent to assert the label is present.
Maya (Infra): agree. action items: 1) Maya open GCP support case + attach exports (ETA today EOD). 2) Oli produce per-day per-region cost CSV for finance (ETA tomorrow AM). 3) Taylor add CI gate for commit label (ETA end of week). 4) Raj prepare provisional ledger adjustment plan if backfill denied (ETA 2 business days).
Raj (Billing): noted. please ping me when the ticket is opened so I can follow with GCP billing reps.
Maya (Infra): pinging now — ticket 1234567890 opened. summary: missing commit label on reserved GPU usage leading to contract credit not applied for invoice `INV-2026-03-09-GCP-7832`. attaching exports and sample rows. (link to support case) :memo:
Oli (SRE): added the aggregated CSV to the case. also included the cluster deploy job id and the change that removed the label.
Raj (Billing): thanks all. keeping this thread for updates. once GCP responds we'll decide on ledger backfill vs. internal credit. :eyes:
